text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In anticipation of the Japanese Derby, Symboli Rudolf throws herself body and soul into training, but Air Groove worries she's pushing herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tries to shut Rudolf out of the student council office to relieve some of the weight from her shoulders, but Rudolf seems dissatisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Symboli Rudolf understands Air Groove's feelings, as both the president and the Emperor, she cannot stop.
